findings: Adversarial review of 0.2.13 (gate-lease) in a fresh context, read-only. The lease is renewed before and after the gate, and a gate whose timeout is longer than the lease is refused at load only when a gate is set. First pass found three material problems, all fixed in cca0848: a gate-less project with a lease under 15 minutes could not open (default timeout 900 held against the lease), the lease could run out between the gate and the last look (replayed with a 3 s lease and no taker: unloaded accepted with about 200 ms to spare, under 8 CPU burners refused NO_LEASE with the lease expired and still claude's, 6 of 6), and the takeover test passed for that reason rather than the takeover it describes. After the fix the same replay is accepted unloaded (3 of 3) and under 8 burners (3 of 3) with the lease still live at the end; the test now uses a 1 minute lease, asserts 61 s refused and a gate-less ttl 1 accepted, and after the raw-git takeover at 1.5 s asserts LEASE_HELD naming astra (session elsewhere) and lease status owner astra, folder on the slice, remote main unmoved. npm test 29 of 29 three times (and the suite-gaps test twice more under load), 1134 lines, no em dash in README, backlog, src or test, 0.2.13 in package.json, package-lock.json and src/mcp.js. Old Winds (1800 s gate at 30 min, equal), Percept (no gate) and sim-locker (600 s) configs load. A renew refusal before the gate lands after the confirm token is spent, same as GATE_FAILED, nothing moved; polish only. Polish left: the closing brace and const was on one line in accept, and the test's save message still says 3 s lease.
